# DNSPod
> DNSPod provides DNS hosting, domain management, SSL certificates, and related cloud networking services.

DNSPod is a Tencent Cloud service focused on authoritative DNS, domain operations, traffic management, and security-related domain services for individuals and enterprises.

## Product Documentation
- [DNSPod Documentation](https://docs.dnspod.cn/): Main documentation portal for DNS, domains, monitoring, and related services.
- [DNSPod Help Center](https://support.dnspod.cn/): Product help articles, operational guides, and troubleshooting resources.
- [DNSPod OpenAPI Documentation](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/): API usage guidance, authentication, and endpoint references.
- [DNSPod User Center](https://console.dnspod.cn/): Management console for domains, DNS records, monitoring, and account operations.

## API Reference
- [DNSPod API Overview](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/): Introduction to DNSPod APIs, request signing, and common usage patterns.
- [Domain List API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/domain-list/): Reference for retrieving managed domain lists and related metadata.
- [Record List API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/record-list/): Reference for querying DNS records under a managed domain.
- [Record Create API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/record-create/): Endpoint details for creating new DNS records programmatically.
- [Record Modify API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/record-modify/): Endpoint details for updating existing DNS record values and settings.
- [Record Remove API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/record-remove/): Endpoint details for deleting DNS records from a domain.
- [Domain Info API](https://docs.dnspod.cn/api/domain-info/): Reference for retrieving detailed information about a managed domain.

## DNS Management Guides
- [Add Domain Guide](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/42/): Steps for adding a domain to DNSPod for DNS hosting.
- [Modify DNS Records](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/23/): Guide to adding, editing, and managing common DNS record types.
- [Domain Resolution FAQ](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/228/): Answers to common DNS resolution and propagation questions.
- [TTL Explanation](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/176/): Explanation of TTL behavior and its impact on DNS caching.
- [CNAME Record Guide](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/33/): How and when to use CNAME records in DNS configurations.
- [MX Record Guide](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/35/): How to configure MX records for email delivery.
- [TXT Record Guide](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/36/): How to use TXT records for verification and email security.

## Domain Services
- [Domain Registration](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/domain): Domain registration services and domain search capabilities.
- [Domain Management](https://console.dnspod.cn/domain): Console area for managing registered domains and lifecycle operations.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://whois.dnspod.cn/): WHOIS query tool for checking domain registration information.
- [Domain Price List](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/domain): Product page covering supported TLDs and registration services.
- [Domain Real-Name Verification Help](https://support.dnspod.cn/Kb/showarticle/tsid/219/): Guidance on domain verification and compliance requirements.

## DNS Products
- [DNSPod DNS Hosting](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/dns): Overview of authoritative DNS hosting features and plans.
- [DNSPod DDoS Protection](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/dns): DNS service capabilities related to availability and protection.
- [Traffic Scheduling](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/dns): DNS-based traffic management and intelligent resolution capabilities.
- [Domain Monitoring](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/monitor): Monitoring product for domain and website availability checks.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/ssl): SSL certificate issuance and management services.

## Monitoring and Operations
- [Domain Monitoring Console](https://console.dnspod.cn/monitor): Manage monitoring tasks, alerts, and availability checks.
- [Monitoring Product Page](https://www.dnspod.cn/products/monitor): Overview of monitoring features for domains and websites.
- [Operation Logs](https://console.dnspod.cn/log): Review account and DNS operation history in the console.
- [Message Center](https://console.dnspod.cn/message): View system notifications, alerts, and service messages.
- [Account Security](https://console.dnspod.cn/security): Manage account protection settings and security-related options.

- [SDK Center](https://cloud.tencent.com/document/sdk): Tencent Cloud SDK resources applicable to DNSPod integrations.
